known_issues: Regression: Leaderboard tab 'Select a date to record results' shows no selectable dates and incorrectly displays 'You must add availability on the Calendar page...' even when availability exists; previously worked prior to latest update. Expected: allow selecting any date with availability.

existing_features.title: Update the frontend Leaderboard page to use the corrected “caller available days” data source so the date dropdown shows selectable dates whenever the user has added availability on the Calendar page.

new_feature_requests.summary: Fix the backend query used to populate the Leaderboard “Select a date to record results” dropdown so it returns all availability days for the caller (including future dates), not a limited/past-only subset.

Correct any backend sorting/logic issues in the existing getCallerAvailableDaysWithLogs implementation so it behaves deterministically and does not contain comparator bugs (even if it remains used for match history).
